items_all.summary: Alibaba's Qwen team has released Qwen-Image-2.1, an open-weight model that generates and edits images on powerful consumer GPUs, with support for transparency and up to ten reference images at once. Its research license bars commercial use, which requires a separate Qwen license. The article Alibaba's open-weight Qwen-Image-2.1 claims to beat closed models in image generation with just 7 billion parameters appeared first on The Decoder .

items_all.title: Tencent's Gander aims to keep talking while it works in the background
items_all.summary: Tencent's Gander processes speech, images, and text while handling tasks in the background. A "cerebellum" keeps the conversation going, while a swappable "brain" searches files, writes code, or tackles other complex work. Users can interrupt or change the task mid-conversation. In benchmarks, Gander interrupted users in just 8 percent of cases, less often than its rivals, but trailed on task accuracy. The article Tencent's Gander aims to keep talking while it works in the background appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 騰訊的 Gander 可以處理語音、影像和文字，同時在背景執行任務。「小腦」維持對話持續進行，而可替換的「大腦」則負責搜尋檔案、撰寫程式碼或處理其他複雜的工作。使用者可以在對話進行到一半時打斷或變更任務。在基準測試中，Gander 打斷使用者的比例僅佔 8%，比競爭對手更少，但在任務準確度上則落後。《The Decoder》網站首先刊登了題為 騰訊的 Gander 旨在於背景工作時持續保持對話 騰訊的 的文章。

items_all.title: Daily AI usage in the U.S. has more than doubled in just six months
items_all.summary: Surveys by Epoch AI and Ipsos suggest AI is becoming part of everyday life for more Americans. The share of US adults using AI almost daily more than doubled between March and August 2026, rising from 8 percent to 19 percent. Meanwhile, the share using it just once a week fell from 17 percent to 10 percent. The article Daily AI usage in the U.S. has more than doubled in just six months appeared first on The Decoder .

items_all.title: Simulated students that make realistic mistakes help AI tutors learn faster
items_all.summary: Microsoft and the University of Illinois built StudentSim to replicate individual students from limited data and give AI tutors fast, low-cost feedback. In tests covering 60 students across chess, English, and math, it outperformed GPT-5.4. A chess tutor trained with StudentSim also earned the highest expert ratings among three versions tested. The article Simulated students that make realistic mistakes help AI tutors learn faster appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 微軟 與伊利諾大學合作建立了 StudentSim，透過有限的資料來模擬個別學生，為 AI 家教提供快速、低成本的回饋。在涵蓋棋藝、英文和數學等 60 名學生的測試中，它的表現優於 GPT-5.4。由 StudentSim 訓練出來的棋藝家教也在受測的三個版本中獲得最高的專家評分。文章〈Simulated students that make realistic mistakes help AI tutors learn faster〉最初發布於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: datasette-auth-github 1.0
items_all.summary: Release: datasette-auth-github 1.0 I run this GitHub login plugin on the agent.datasette.io demo site and I noticed that my authenticated sessions weren't lasting very long. It turned out that the plugin was setting cookies without a Max-Age parameter, so they were expiring at the end of a browser session (which in Mobile Safari seems to happen pretty often, independently of how you are using the app.) I fixed that in #80 and, since this plugin has been around for quite a while and is tested against both Datasette 0.65.x and Datasette 1.0ax, I decided to bump it up to a 1.0 release. I'm trying to get better at promoting stable plugins to 1.0. Tags: github , plugins , datasette

items_all_raw.title: Tencent's Gander aims to keep talking while it works in the background
items_all_raw.summary: Tencent's Gander processes speech, images, and text while handling tasks in the background. A "cerebellum" keeps the conversation going, while a swappable "brain" searches files, writes code, or tackles other complex work. Users can interrupt or change the task mid-conversation. In benchmarks, Gander interrupted users in just 8 percent of cases, less often than its rivals, but trailed on task accuracy. The article Tencent's Gander aims to keep talking while it works in the background appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 騰訊的 Gander 可以處理語音、影像和文字，同時在背景執行任務。「小腦」維持對話持續進行，而可替換的「大腦」則負責搜尋檔案、撰寫程式碼或處理其他複雜的工作。使用者可以在對話進行到一半時打斷或變更任務。在基準測試中，Gander 打斷使用者的比例僅佔 8%，比競爭對手更少，但在任務準確度上則落後。《The Decoder》網站首先刊登了題為 騰訊的 Gander 旨在於背景工作時持續保持對話 騰訊的 的文章。

items_all_raw.summary: Microsoft and the University of Illinois built StudentSim to replicate individual students from limited data and give AI tutors fast, low-cost feedback. In tests covering 60 students across chess, English, and math, it outperformed GPT-5.4. A chess tutor trained with StudentSim also earned the highest expert ratings among three versions tested. items_all_raw.title: datasette-auth-github 1.0
items_all_raw.summary: Release: datasette-auth-github 1.0 I run this GitHub login plugin on the agent.datasette.io demo site and I noticed that my authenticated sessions weren't lasting very long. It turned out that the plugin was setting cookies without a Max-Age parameter, so they were expiring at the end of a browser session (which in Mobile Safari seems to happen pretty often, independently of how you are using the app.) I fixed that in #80 and, since this plugin has been around for quite a while and is tested against both Datasette 0.65.x and Datasette 1.0ax, I decided to bump it up to a 1.0 release. I'm trying to get better at promoting stable plugins to 1.0. Tags: github , plugins , datasette
